title: What games would you like to see combined?
author: Lazy-Topic-7745
selftext: With these new Ai modding tools, what games do you think would be cool to see combined?

comments.author: moreicescream
comments.body:
Im not telling u because im doing it rn!🤣

Joking.   
I like MMORPGs combined with legal botting. Is there any sense here if everyone is cheating? Not sure but I’m not 20 anymore so unfortunately my time is pretty limited but I’d still like the illusion of making progress in a game

comments.author: InsolentCoolRadio
comments.body: State of Emergency and The Sims

comments.author: Cristazio
comments.body: Not a project I'm working on but Bayonetta and Devil May Cry would be cool to see. Hell even a multiplayer mod where you and a friend can play both would be amazing

comments.author: potentially__potent
comments.body: Am I the only not really arsed about combined games? They have their own charm, so it's confuses my brain seeing both at the same time. Maybe I'm in the minority here 😂

replies.author: Lazy-Topic-7745
replies.body: The combing is still very clunky imo. But I can only imagine how things will be in the future. Honestly friggin scary. It is weird seeing the combos, but with the amount of amazing games available, I can only imagine that there are going to be some spectacular amalgamations. If you haven't, I'd recommend checking out a game called Vholume. It's basically mirrors edge, but damn it's so good. I can only imagine what those parkour mechanics will look like in games like gta and cyberpunk and others. The modding scene this year is just absolutely insane.

comments.author: Yomuro
comments.body: PoE2 and PoE1, take the best from each game.

replies.author: Lazy-Topic-7745
replies.body: Yoh, that would be amazing. Imagine mirrors edge or Vholume with cyberpunk!
